## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das lässt mich nicht los** — [dahs lesst mish nisht lohs] — *"It won't let go of me" (something stays on your mind)*
2. **Ich bin ganz bei dir** — [ish bin gahnts by deer] — *"I'm completely with you" (I fully agree/support you)*
3. **Es liegt mir am Herzen** — [es leekt meer ahm HAIR-tsen] — *"It's close to my heart" (it matters deeply to me)*
